page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated physical cores utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with a single thread per core, providing 128 vCPUs. It is equipped with 1024.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring reliance on external network-attached storage for data persistence. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps. The lack of hyperthreading means each vCPU maps directly to a physical core, which eliminates resource contention between threads but limits concurrent thread density compared to hyperthreaded alternatives.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory density and dedicated core allocation position this instance for workloads requiring large in-memory footprints without GPU acceleration. It is suitable for large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning applications, and memory-intensive data processing pipelines.
